title: Assling Wildlife Park East Tyrol
name: Assling Wildlife Park East Tyrol
kurzbeschreibung: Wildpark Assling in East Tyrol: 80,000 m² open-air enclosure on the Pustertal sun terrace featuring 35 alpine animal species and an alpine coaster.
beschreibung:
Overview

The traditional Wildpark Assling is located on the sun-drenched Pustertaler sun terrace in the East Tyrolean municipality of Assling (Bezirk Lienz) at an altitude of approximately 1,260 metres. Set against the dramatic backdrop of the towering Lienzer Dolomiten, this family-run wildlife park covers more than 80,000 square metres of natural forest and meadow terrain, offering an authentic habitat for over 35 native alpine animal species. For more than four decades, the park has ranked among East Tyrol's most cherished excursion destinations for families and wildlife enthusiasts.

Alpine Wildlife & Summer Toboggan Run

Along a two-kilometre shaded circular trail through the mountain forest, visitors encounter shy and majestic alpine creatures living in spacious, species-appropriate enclosures. Highlights include impressive alpine ibexes, red deer, fallow deer, chamois, wild boars, marmots, lynx, raccoons, and golden eagles. At several feeding stations, tame deer and goats can be fed by hand using dedicated feed pellets from the park. Children particularly cherish the generous petting zoo and the adventurous playground. Bordering the wildlife park directly is the exhilarating Fun Alpin Osttirol summer toboggan run: on track-guided sledges, riders of all ages race down into the valley through banked turns and dips. Furthermore, a historic demonstration blacksmith shop and a heritage sawmill offer fascinating glimpses into historic rural craftsmanship.

Visit & Getting There

Wildpark Assling is open daily from early April to late October from 09:00 to 19:00 (in July and August until 19:30; special weekend opening hours during winter). Admission prices (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €12.00, seniors approx. €10.50, children (aged 6 to 14) approx. €7.00, small children free; family ticket approx. €34.00. Holders of the regional Glockner-Dolomiten Card receive discounts. Tickets for the summer toboggan run are sold separately at the coaster ticket office. Getting there by car: via the B100 (Drautalstraße) between Lienz and Sillian, turn off at Thal and follow the Pustertaler Höhenstraße up to Assling/Unterassling (large free car park directly at the entrance). By public transport: train to Thal station, then continue with the local bus service to Assling.

Tips

The circular trail through the wildlife park runs mostly along fortified forest tracks and is easily manageable with all-terrain strollers. Right by the park entrance, the welcoming Bärenwirt-Gaststube inn serves hearty East Tyrolean homestyle cooking (including signature Schlipfkrapfen ravioli!) paired with panoramic views of the Dolomites.
